result:
The proposed answer of codimension 1 is probably wrong, though I could not derive the correct value here.

The sketch is not a real argument. It asserts that a single Noether–Lefschetz condition cuts out both families, but gives no lattice computation to support this. The claim that the "non-split type" gives T ≠ 1 with T|_C = 1 is stated without proof.

The structure of the problem also points away from codimension 1. The nodal Coble surfaces already form a hypersurface in the 9-dimensional moduli space. The problem treats the second family as a distinct, rarer locus, so a codimension different from 1 is more plausible. Requiring the Pompilj involution to act as the identity on C ≅ ℙ¹ should impose several independent conditions, not just one. My recollection is that the known result gives a higher codimension (I think 2 or 3), but I am not certain of the exact number.

VERDICT: REJECT
